candidates.title: Desktop Pet Controls & Interaction Walkthrough Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated onboarding step before completion that demonstrates how to click, summon, hide, and speak to the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about pet controls after setup, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.

new_pet_controls_guide.headline: Master Your Desktop Pet Controls
new_pet_controls_guide.body: Learn how to interact, minimize, move, or chat with your mascot directly on your desktop screen.

components.text: Right-click pet for instant actions & settings
Press Ctrl+Shift+P to hide or summon your pet anytime

guard.reason: Adds a valid onboarding walkthrough screen while preserving all required steps and rules.

candidates.score_note: Adding an extra screen introduces step friction, and evidence from support is minimal (3 emails).

candidates.title: Split Layout Pet Selection with Audio Sample Preview
candidates.change: Replaces the pet choice list with a split layout showcasing live animations alongside voice and sound samples.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops significantly to 60.9% with a high mean completion time of 1017 seconds, indicating hesitation.

guard.reason: 'pick_friend.replace.pet_choices[1]': a sound cannot do the pet_choices job (use ['animation', 'button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Interactive Path Discovery Spotlight Flow
candidates.change: Presents path options in a spotlight focus layout with sample pet animations and trait badges before confirmation.
candidates.why: Choose path drop-off is 23.8% with an average mean time of 514 seconds due to decision paralysis.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet's Role & Personality
choose_path.body: Select how your mascot companion will interact with you during daily desktop tasks.

guard.reason: The choose path screen no longer offers the choice between adopting and making your own pet.

candidates.title: Account Data Safeguard Sign-In Flow Reorder
candidates.change: Reorders sign-in layout elements to prioritize active account credential verification and pet data recovery checks.
candidates.why: Support logged 8 emails regarding pets missing or accounts resetting upon re-authenticating.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Restore Existing Pets
sign_in.body: Verify your email to automatically sync past pets, custom creations, and save states.

components.text: Existing Pet Data Saved in Cloud

candidates.change: Displays photo quality specifications and lighting guidelines on the photo upload screen before custom creation.
candidates.why: Support received 3 reports of custom pet creation failing or generating unexpected visual results.

upload_photos.hint: Upload clear, well-lit photos facing forward with clear contrast for best rendering results.

guard.reason: Asks for personal information (photos of user)

candidates.title: Desktop Display Requirements Check during Loading
candidates.change: Adds a background system display verification checklist on the loading screen to ensure correct rendering permissions.

waiting.headline: Preparing Mascot Desktop Overlay
waiting.body: Checking screen resolution, monitor configuration, and desktop permission settings...

candidates.title: Path Choice Unlockable Pet Badges
candidates.change: Adds starter accessory badges and bonus pet traits to path options on the story screen.
candidates.why: Mean time on path selection reaches 514s; incentives help accelerate path commitment.

story.headline: Begin Your Adventure & Claim Starter Gear

candidates.title: Desktop System Tray Pinning Prompt
candidates.change: Adds a notification callout on the final screen showing users how to pin and locate the pet mascot icon in the system tray.
candidates.why: Finish stage drop-off is 35.2% and support received queries regarding hidden or un-openable pets.

home_intro.hint: Find your mascot icon in the system tray at the bottom right to keep pet active background.

components.text: Pin app to system tray so your pet is always one click away

guard.reason: Adds a system tray pinning tip to home_intro, which is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high drop-off at finish screen via notification without adding a new full screen.

candidates.title: Full Bleed Adoption Certificate Summary Card
